actor_kind.description: Directory / UX classification only. MUST NOT participate in authorization, reducer acceptance, capability resolution, or any wire-protocol decision: those MUST consult DID + Grant + Constraint exclusively. Implementations are free to use actor_kind for icon selection, directory filtering and presentation, but a wrong value MUST NOT widen or narrow what a principal can do. Does NOT include 'device': a device is not an actor principal and has no DID of its own; its identity is device_id (ak:device:<uuid>) plus a verification method under the owning principal DID. See zh/models/actor.md.

handle.description: Arkret canonical handle string: <localpart>:<domain>. The @ mention sigil is not part of the handle.

agent_slug.description: Projection hint for a controller-scoped selector slug backed by ak.schema.agent_selector_claim.v1. Only valid when actor_kind=agent under ak.profile.personal_agent_provisioning.v1; it is not a global handle and MUST NOT be used for authorization, attribution, or Directory discovery. The mention input token @<controller-handle>/<agent_slug> resolves to this actor's principal_id before persistence only after selector claim validation.

status.description: Public projection of the account lifecycle status values defined in zh/identity/account-lifecycle.md §3. Implementations MAY hide or coarsen this field in projection views, but the wire enum mirrors ak.account.status.
